title: Minimal Recurrent Behavioral Memory for Imitation under Partial Observability
abstract: arXiv:2609.25757v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: What is the least recurrent memory needed to reproduce a specified expert under partial observability? The instantaneous requirement is the conditional entropy of the expert's behavioral quotient, but recurrence must also preserve distinctions that future observations will not restore before use. We characterize this minimal recurrent behavioral memory by a compatibility relation: under transitivity its classes attain the exact minimum, while the general case is an entropy minimization over closed compatible state assignments, with exact certificates on finite instances. A sole-carrier measurement protocol separates behavioral sufficiency, excess code rate, and information carried by observations or other memory paths; experimental bit requirements refer to the induced symbolic behavioral model under the stated occupancy. Across manipulation tasks, learned code rates remain near zero- and two-bit requirements as hidden modes grow to $512

translated_title: 部分可观测性下用于模仿学习的最小循环行为记忆
translated_abstract: 在部分可观测条件下，复现一个指定专家策略所需的最小循环记忆是多少？瞬时需求由专家行为商的条件熵给出，但循环记忆还必须保留那些未来观测在使用之前无法恢复的区分。我们通过一个兼容性关系来刻画这种最小循环行为记忆：在传递性条件下，其等价类可以达到精确的最小值；而在一般情形下，问题转化为对封闭兼容状态分配的熵最小化，并在有限实例上给出精确证书。我们提出一种单一载体测量协议，将行为充分性、超额码率以及由观测或其他记忆路径携带的信息分离开来；实验中的比特需求指的是在所述占用条件下诱导出的符号化行为模型。在多个操作任务中，随着隐藏模式数量增长到512，学习到的码率仍保持在接近零比特和两比特的理论需求水平。
tldr: 该论文通过兼容性关系刻画了部分可观测环境下模仿专家所需的最小循环行为记忆，并证明随着隐藏模式增多，学习到的记忆码率仍接近零比特和两比特的理论最小需求。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the minimal recurrent behavioral memory needed for imitation under partial observability via a compatibility relation, showing that learned code rates remain near the theoretical zero- and two-bit requirements even as hidden modes grow to 512.
